## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Meditron 70B (Q4_K_M, needs ~41.4 GB, from [huggingface.co/TheBloke](https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF/tree/9de500efc168c000799aaf3186717fce3bb88829))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q2_K (~29.3 GB) `llama cli -hf TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF:Q2_K`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Meditron 70B (Q4_K_M, needs ~41.4 GB, from [huggingface.co/TheBloke](https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF/tree/9de500efc168c000799aaf3186717fce3bb88829))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q2_K (~29.3 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF@Q2_K -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Meditron 70B (Q4_K_M, needs ~41.4 GB, from [huggingface.co/TheBloke](https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF/tree/9de500efc168c000799aaf3186717fce3bb88829))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q2_K (~29.3 GB) `ollama run hf.co/TheBloke/meditron-70B-GGUF:Q2_K`

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~137.95 GB, from [huggingface.co/epfl-llm](https://huggingface.co/epfl-llm/meditron-70b/tree/3b41343851aa43d8de0187740a4357c0b4ddaffa))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' --with accelerate python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='epfl-llm/meditron-70b', torch_dtype='auto', device_map='auto')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/epfl-llm](https://huggingface.co/epfl-llm/meditron-70b)
